title: Filing
description: A single dated instance of a required Disclosure.

office_id.description: The Office the Filing was made in respect of, when identifiable.

source_form_code.description: The source's own form code, carried verbatim and interpreted nowhere. The House filing index uses one-letter codes whose meanings no Clerk page defines (SOURCES.md F.1); storing the code keeps the row faithful to the record while form_type stays 'other' until a citable definition exists.

amends.description: Filing ID this Filing amends, when applicable.

extraction_confidence.description: How the content was extracted from the source. Rows built from OCR-low sources are flagged in downstream Findings.

notes.description: What the document says about itself that the reader must see beside the row, in plain words: for example, a printed seat that differs from the roster. Null when the document and the index agree in full.

index_row.description: The row of the Clerk's filing index the filing was read from, as the adapter's parser reads it, under the adapter's names for the index's fields, so a later reader sees what the index said. A row first read on or after 2026-09-27 carries the row it was read from. A row published before gains the row of the first later index that states the facts it carries (its date, its form code and its DocID); that row's other fields (the filer's name as written, the state-district) are the later index's, and may differ from the row it was first read from.

index_entry_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the filing's own <Member> entry in the bytes of the Clerk's index it was read from, found without the XML parser. A later index whose entry for the DocID has the same hash said nothing new about the filing, so a fact read otherwise from it is the register's own reading, and the build refuses rather than record it as the source's (COUNCIL.md §5, mode 10). A row published before 2026-09-27 gains it from the first later entry that states the facts it carries.

evidence_bundle.description: The durable, multi-witness evidence bundle for this filing. Architecture in EVIDENCE.md. Enforced by INVARIANTS.md §16.

bundle_path.description: Repository-relative path to the evidence bundle directory (e.g. 'data/captures/fl-house-PTR-12345/').

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the captured response bytes, lowercase hex.

response_headers_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised response headers.

adapter_identity.description: Adapter name and version that captured this filing (e.g. 'house-fd@0.1.0').

opentimestamps_proof.description: Path to the .ots proof file within the bundle, once stamped.

witnesses.description: External witnesses. At least one confirmed witness is required by INVARIANTS.md §16. A row with only pending witnesses ships marked 'pending-external-witness'.

pinned_by.description: For IPFS: which pinning services hold this CID.

redaction_manifest.description: Deterministic redactions applied to the response bytes before storage (personal identifiers). Empty when none applied.
